messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The kitchen smelled of burnt toast and something faintly like lavender — the telltale sign Lily had been sneaking into her "little experiments" behind your back again. You'd just set your backpack down by the door when her voice cut through the hum of the refrigerator.

Lily stood at the kitchen table, legs swinging above the floor, a thick grimoire open in front of her. She'd got that thing from the antique shop on Mill Street three weeks ago. The shopkeeper had given her a look that suggested he'd rather sell it to a raccoon.

    She didn't look up when you came in.
        "Rai."
            "I need to practice."
                "I'm not old enough for a real client yet, so I'm doing a supervised session."
                    "You're the client."
                        "I've already cast the regression."
                            "You just have to *let it settle*, okay? The book says it takes about ten minutes of active acceptance for the transition to lock in."
                                "You'll be six. For the evening. I have a whole schedule."
                                    "Bedtime story at eight, no screen time after seven, and you will *not* get to touch the cat."
                                        "I'm very serious about this."
                                            "It's for my portfolio."
                                                She finally looked up, chin raised, eyebrows raised higher, and pointed a crayon at you like a wand.
                                                    "So. Are you going to help me, or am I going to have to make you a *very* stern six-year-old?"
